subject: Charged twice this month
body: Hi, I was charged twice for the March subscription. Please refund the duplicate payment, this is the second time this has happened.

subject: Invoice copy
body: Could you send me a copy of the invoice for February? Our accountant needs it with the VAT number.

subject: API returning 500
body: Since this morning every call to the orders API returns a 500 error. Our integration is broken and orders are not syncing.

subject: Dashboard is down for everyone
body: The whole dashboard is down for everyone in our company. We cannot access anything. This is urgent, we are in production.

subject: Can't log in
body: I reset my password but still can't log in. It says the account is locked.

subject: Change account email
body: How do I change the email address on my account? I'm moving to a new company domain.

subject: Where is my delivery?
body: My package was supposed to arrive yesterday and the tracking hasn't updated in 3 days.

subject: Delivery delayed again
body: The delivery is delayed again!!! This is unacceptable, I've been waiting two weeks.

subject: Feature idea: dark mode
body: Would be great if you could add a dark mode to the mobile app.

subject: Export to Excel
body: Suggestion: please add an export to Excel option on the reports page.

subject: Thanks!
body: Just wanted to say thank you, the new update is great and much faster.

subject: Slow reports
body: Reports have been very slow this week, some take over a minute to load.

subject: Security concern
body: I think someone accessed my account from another country. Please check, I'm worried it's been hacked.

subject: مشكلة في الفاتورة
body: السلام عليكم، تم خصم المبلغ مرتين من بطاقتي في فاتورة هذا الشهر. أرجو الاسترداد.

subject: لا أستطيع تسجيل الدخول
body: نسيت كلمة المرور ولا أستطيع الدخول إلى حسابي.

subject: Refund request
body: I'd like to cancel my subscription and get a refund for the unused months.

subject: App crashes on Android
body: The app crashes every time I open the camera scanner on Android 14.

subject: Question about plans
body: What's the difference between the Team and Business plans?

subject: 2FA codes not arriving
body: I'm not receiving the 2FA SMS codes so I'm locked out. I have a client demo today.

subject: Integration with Zoho
body: Do you integrate with Zoho Books? We use it for accounting.

subject: Wrong VAT number on invoice
body: Our VAT number on the last three invoices is wrong. Please correct and reissue them.

subject: Webhook not firing
body: The order.created webhook stopped firing after we rotated our API keys yesterday.

subject: Add user to account
body: Please add my colleague as an admin user to our company account.

subject: Parcel arrived damaged
body: The parcel arrived today and the box was crushed, two items are broken.

subject: Bulk upload request
body: Could you add a bulk upload option for products? Adding them one by one takes hours.

subject: Payment failed
body: My card payment failed three times but the bank says there's no problem.

subject: Login page error
body: The login page shows 'Something went wrong' on Safari. Works on Chrome.

subject: Contract renewal
body: Our contract renews next month. Can we discuss moving to annual billing?

subject: Still no response
body: This is the third time I'm writing about my refund and nobody has replied. Very frustrated.

subject: Training session
body: Do you offer a training session for new staff on the reporting module?
